source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 李强抵达西藏吉隆指导抢险救灾工作
topics.official_english: Premier Li Qiang arrives in Gyirong, Xizang to guide disaster relief work
topics.why_hot: A severe disaster in Gyirong drew a top-level government response, and the premier's on-site presence made relief efforts a national focus.
topics.share_angle: Use the story to explain how China coordinates large-scale disaster response and why border towns like Gyirong require special attention.

topics.chinese_topic: 西藏泥石流已致3人遇难558人失联
topics.official_english: Xizang mudslide leaves 3 dead and 558 unaccounted for
topics.why_hot: The unusually high number of unaccounted-for people makes this a rapidly evolving disaster story and a top public concern.
topics.share_angle: Clarify the scale of the disaster, rescue difficulties, and how terms like 'unaccounted for' are used in official reporting.

topics.chinese_topic: 江西省省长叶建春被查
topics.official_english: Jiangxi Governor Ye Jianchun placed under investigation
topics.why_hot: A sitting provincial governor being publicly named in an anti-corruption investigation is a major political story in China.
topics.share_angle: Explain the standard anti-corruption procedure and stress that conclusions should wait for official announcements.

topics.chinese_topic: 中方：尼泊尔一侧失联中国公民近百人
topics.official_english: China says nearly 100 Chinese citizens unaccounted for on Nepal side
topics.why_hot: The safety of overseas Chinese citizens is an emotional topic, especially when many people are unaccounted for after flooding in Nepal.
topics.share_angle: Focus on consular protection, cross-border rescue challenges, and practical advice for nationals in disaster-hit areas.

topics.chinese_topic: 尼泊尔山洪死亡人数升至270人
topics.official_english: Death toll from flash floods in Nepal rises to 270
topics.why_hot: The mounting human toll in Nepal highlights the severity of the Himalayan flood disaster and draws regional attention.
topics.share_angle: Use this to show the disaster's regional significance and the humanitarian challenges facing Nepal.

topics.official_english: New rules on RMB purchase and sale take effect
topics.why_hot: Currency rules affect foreign exchange, investment, and daily financial choices, so the new regulation quickly sparked public questions.
topics.share_angle: Explain the practical impact of the new RMB rules on individuals and businesses without giving financial advice.

topics.chinese_topic: 人民日报：“维权”岂能当生意
topics.official_english: People's Daily: Rights protection should not become a business
topics.why_hot: An official newspaper commentary on the commercialization of rights protection triggered debate over consumer activism and abuse of legal claims.
topics.share_angle: Translate the editorial's argument and present balanced views on where legitimate consumer rights end and profit-driven claims begin.

topics.chinese_topic: 填志愿和父母吵了18年来最厉害的架
topics.official_english: Student says college application triggered biggest fight with parents in 18 years
topics.why_hot: It is college application season in China, and family disagreements over schools and majors resonate with millions of students and parents.
topics.share_angle: Explore the generational gap in education choices and the pressure Chinese families face during application season.
